change: Unpacking parameters reuse declaration patterns and ordinary value semantics; nested pattern names shadow outer parameters in default dependency analysis.
bootstrap: Independent included C seed, three compiler generations.
coverage: Native/web default/release arrays, records, dictionaries, imported tuples, fixed arrays, generics, defaults, evaluation order, named adjacent parameters, captured mutation, callback inference, nested patterns, runtime length failures and duplicate/mutable-pattern diagnostics.
limits: Whole patterns are positional value parameters. Mutable patterns and per-leaf annotations remain unsupported; pattern names are body bindings, unavailable to later parameter defaults. No performance claim.
